questions.prompt: If the net force on an object is zero, what is its acceleration in an inertial frame?
A \(20\,\mathrm{N}\) weight hangs motionless from a vertical string. Find the string tension.
questions.answer:
For a motionless weight,
\[
\sum F_y=T-20=0
\]
\[
T=20\,\mathrm{N}
\]

questions.prompt: A car moves at constant velocity while air resistance is \(700\,\mathrm{N}\) backward. Find the forward driving force.
questions.answer:
Constant velocity means zero net force, so the driving force must balance air resistance:
\[
F_{\mathrm{drive}}=700\,\mathrm{N}
\]
forward.

questions.prompt: A \(5.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) block rests on a horizontal table. Find the normal force using \(g=9.8\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}\).
An \(8.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) speaker hangs at rest from a vertical cable. Find the cable tension.
A box at rest is pulled right by \(9\,\mathrm{N}\). Find the leftward force needed for horizontal equilibrium.
questions.answer:
Horizontal equilibrium requires equal opposite forces:
\[
9-F_{\mathrm{left}}=0
\]
\[
F_{\mathrm{left}}=9\,\mathrm{N}
\]

questions.prompt: A \(10\,\mathrm{kg}\) block rests on a frictionless \(20^\circ\) incline, held by a string parallel to the slope. Find the string tension.
questions.answer:
Along the slope, tension balances the downslope component of weight:
\[
T=mg\sin20^\circ
\]
\[
T=10(9.8)\sin20^\circ=33.5\,\mathrm{N}
\]

questions.prompt: A \(12\,\mathrm{kg}\) sign hangs from two identical cables, each \(30^\circ\) from the vertical. Find the tension in each cable and the horizontal force each cable exerts on the sign.
questions.answer:
The vertical components of the two tensions support the sign:
\[
2T\cos30^\circ=mg
\]
\[
T=\frac{12(9.8)}{2\cos30^\circ}=67.9\,\mathrm{N}
\]
Horizontal component of each cable is
\[
T_x=T\sin30^\circ=33.9\,\mathrm N
\]
directed toward the sign's center from each side.

questions.prompt: A \(12\,\mathrm{kg}\) crate is pulled by \(40\,\mathrm{N}\) at \(30^\circ\) above horizontal and remains at rest on a rough floor. Find the friction force and normal force, then the minimum \(\mu_s\) required for equilibrium.
questions.answer:
The pull components are
\[
F_x=40\cos30^\circ=34.6\,\mathrm{N}
\]
\[
F_y=40\sin30^\circ=20.0\,\mathrm{N}
\]
Horizontal equilibrium gives friction \(34.6\,\mathrm{N}\) left. Vertically,
\[
N+20.0-mg=0
\]
\[
N=12(9.8)-20.0=97.6\,\mathrm{N}
\]
Minimum static friction coefficient for this equilibrium is
\[
\mu_s^{\min}=\frac{f_s}{N}=\frac{34.6}{97.6}=0.355
\]

questions.prompt: A \(20\,\mathrm{kg}\) sign is held at a joint by a horizontal cable pulling left and a second cable pulling \(40^\circ\) above the horizontal to the right. A steady horizontal wind also pushes the sign right with \(90\,\mathrm{N}\). Find both cable tensions.
questions.answer:
Let \(T_2\) be the angled cable tension and \(T_1\) the horizontal cable tension. Vertical balance gives
\[
T_2\sin40^\circ=mg=20(9.8)
\]
\[
T_2=305\,\mathrm{N}
\]
Horizontal balance with rightward wind force \(90\,\mathrm N\):
\[
T_2\cos40^\circ+90-T_1=0
\]
\[
T_1=T_2\cos40^\circ+90=324\,\mathrm{N}
\]
